name: Being A Kid
overview: Scripture reveals that children are a precious heritage and reward from the Lord, symbolizing both blessing and responsibility within the family (Psalms 127:3; Proverbs 17:6). The Bible emphasizes the importance of training children in the ways of the Lord so that they remain faithful throughout life (Proverbs 22:6). Jesus teaches the value of protecting and honoring children, highlighting their special place in God's kingdom and care (Matthew 18:10). Furthermore, those who receive Christ are granted the privilege to become children of God, reflecting a spiritual identity rooted in faith (John 1:12). The joy and hope associated with new life are also acknowledged, portraying children as a source of lasting joy beyond initial struggles (John 16:21).
